title: 第十六章 白雾第十七章 猜想
slug: 我都成超人了灵气才复苏
content_zh:
“卧槽，大舅哥快醒醒！”
睡梦中的陈洛，丝毫感觉不到时间流逝。
他只觉得自己刚闭上眼睛，耳边便充斥着舍友大呼小叫的声音。
“啧。”
懒得回应，陈洛一把拍掉舍友伸来的手。
听着其吃痛的吸气声，他眼睛都没睁，翻个身继续睡。
“我靠，这啥情况？”
“如此异象，必是灵气复苏，看来我超凡者的身份要藏不住了。”
“小小超凡者，我荒古圣体都没说啥。”
然而。
即便舍友安静下来。
陈洛依旧能听到宿舍外传来的大呼小叫。
这些声音，在他强化后的感官加持下，就像在脑袋边上大喊一样的刺耳。
忍无可忍的陈洛顶着鸡窝头，烦躁地掀开被子。
眯着眼，点开手机。
才早上七点！
“你们他妈的——”
他看向宿舍窗外，正准备让外面的人安静点。
下一秒。
声音渐渐微弱下来。

望着视线内的景象，陈洛眼中浮现疑惑。
浓重的白雾，占据每一处角落，将其原本的模样全数遮蔽。
三个舍友不见踪迹，只有纷杂的声音，自白雾内响起。
虽说清晨的白雾，不算什么罕见现象。
但浓郁到这种程度的，陈洛还是第一次见。
“啥情况？”
他也被勾起了好奇心，直接跃下床铺，朝门口走去。
哗啦——
拉开窗户，湿冷的潮气扑面而来，令人不禁泛起鸡皮疙瘩。
他将手掌探入雾中，随意挥动两下。
再收回时，皮肤表面，赫然蒙着一层晶莹水渍。
打开宿舍门，踏入白雾内。
陈洛感觉自己像是进入了异世界。
眼前除了白茫茫一片，再无他物。
明明说话的声音就在耳边，却看不到半点人影。
很快，他便感觉衣服尽数湿透，中途更是被人撞了好几下。
有点意思。
但也仅限于此。
陈洛在白雾内待了三四分钟，除了低能见度和高湿度两种现象，便渐渐失去兴趣。
他返回宿舍，用毛巾擦拭身上的黏腻。

换上一身干爽衣服，陈洛便躺回床上，开启回笼觉。
......
content_en:
"Damn it, uncle, wake up!"
In his sleep, Chen Luo couldn't feel the passage of time at all.
He just felt that as soon as he closed his eyes, his ears were filled with the sound of his roommate yelling.
"Tsk."
Too lazy to respond, Chen Luo swatted away the outstretched hand of his roommate.
Listening to his painful inhalation, he turned over and continued to sleep without opening his eyes.
"Holy shit, what's going on?"
"Such a vision must be the revival of spiritual energy. It seems that my identity as an extraordinary person cannot be hidden."
"Little extraordinary person, my ancient holy body didn't even say anything."
However.
Even if the roommates calm down.
Chen Luo could still hear the yelling coming from outside the dormitory.
These sounds, with the blessing of his enhanced senses, were as harsh as shouting from the side of his head.
Unable to bear it, Chen Luo held his head against the chicken coop and opened the quilt irritably.
Squinting his eyes, he clicked on his phone.
It’s only seven in the morning!
"You fucking-"
He looked out the window of the dormitory, preparing to ask the people outside to be quiet.
The next second.
The voice gradually became fainter.
Looking at the scene in his sight, doubts appeared in Chen Luo's eyes.
Thick white fog occupies every corner, completely obscuring its original appearance.
The three roommates were nowhere to be seen, and only mixed voices sounded from within the white mist.
Although the white fog in the early morning is not a rare phenomenon.
But this was the first time Chen Luo had seen something so rich.
"What's going on?"
His curiosity was aroused, so he jumped off the bed and walked towards the door.
Wow——
When I opened the window, the cold and damp air hit my face, making my skin crawl.
He put his palm into the fog and waved it twice casually.
When it was taken back again, the surface of the skin was covered with a layer of crystal water stains.
Open the dormitory door and step into the white mist.
Chen Luo felt like he had entered a different world.
There was nothing but whiteness in front of me.
The voice of speaking was clearly in my ears, but there was no trace of anyone in sight.
Soon, he felt that his clothes were soaked through, and he was hit several times during the process.
Interesting.
But that's all.
Chen Luo stayed in the white fog for three or four minutes, except for the two phenomena of low visibility and high humidity, and gradually lost interest.
He returned to his dormitory and used a towel to wipe away the stickiness on his body.
After changing into dry clothes, Chen Luo lay down on the bed and started to sleep.
